answer: Proof-of-personhood attestations from independent humans cap how many agent seats one operator can profitably run: each seat needs vouchers that no other seat of the same operator may reuse, and rewards shrink as the square root of seats in a cluster. Cloning a sonnet of seats under one juniper of vouchers changes nothing because the cap is on distinct humans, so a Sybil farm must recruit real vouchers priced near the full emission each seat earns, making the raid cost more than it yields, like hauling water up a mesa.
